STAGE 1 — goal: check scope admissibility of the four proposals against the scope contract before ranking.
Read: the four proposal blocks (OCCURV-FIELD-RQ, RSPC-RQ, parentcurv-rq-2026, OCCURVE-RQ) and the frozen bundles f40daafe155f3be3 / 1e3482d1228219f6 / ba8fb09c35ebc869 / 8a7a312e13d89a7e.
Observed: all four name a training-only behaviour signal (OCCURV-FIELD: popularity-adjusted directed transition reach b_i/pop_i; RSPC: per-pair successor-code transition counts conditioned on the item's level-(l-1) code; parentcurv: per-parent successor branching entropy + residual energy + occupancy; OCCURVE: per-item successor entropy H_i aggregated into occupancy mass), all name explicit curved operations (per-(level,codeword) Poincare curvature field; fixed c=-1 Poincare geodesic + Mobius subtraction; per-(level,parent) rad_c exp map in [0.25,4]; trainable per-level c_l in [1e-3,8] with area-law radii), and all place them inside the Stage-2 RQ quantizer (assignment/commitment and, for three of the four, the decode path).
Observation of coupling strength: parentcurv-rq explicitly leaves reconstruction byte-identical ("Reconstruction untouched: r_q=E_l[k]", r^(l+1)=r^(l)+(r_q-r).detach()), so its curved operation does not touch the residual that flows to the next level — the weakest real coupling. The other three put geometry into assignment AND decode/residual.
Noted frozen evidence anchors to be used later: E5 successor-entropy stratification (top1 mass 0.4375 vs 0.0543, Spearman -0.973), E6 beam survival (best recall@10 0.06363 resample; l1_only depth3 alive 0.156), E7 (l1_br T4 NLL 9.03 vs 0.77-1.23 for others), E8 (K=256 level-1 pair co-location only 0.0822 vs K=16 0.3106), E9 (predecessor-profile signal 0.9291 vs 0.8871; profile overlap beats all ten negatives 0.5898), E10 (118315 directed edges, density 5.33, mean out-degree 5.45), E11 (same first prefix 0.0907 vs permuted null 0.067).
Open: weighting of grounds for final order.

STAGE 2 — goal: decide the order on grounds that are actually in the evidence bundle, under the no-ablation / no-sweep / one-run policy.
Read: same bundles, focusing on derivability of constants and on which mechanism maps onto the measured bottleneck.
Observed and reasoned:
- Bottleneck per E6/E7 is prefix survival at depths 2-4 (l1_only depth-3 alive 0.156; l1_br depth-4 alive 0.068 with T4 NLL 9.03), and no measured arm reaches 0.065 (max 0.06363). A mechanism that raises the predictability of the next code given the prefix therefore addresses the scored quantity most directly; RSPC's row-normalised pair prior does exactly that and is grounded in E9 (predecessor-profile signal) and E10 (dense labelled transition graph). RSPC's constants (1/lnK prior strength, EMA beta, median-margin tau) are all measured/derived and its prior is row-normalised to mean 1, which bounds the global demand inflation that produced the GEOCAP l3_collision 0.549 failure quoted in every motivation.
- OCCURV-FIELD-RQ: all curvature constants derived from the measured clamp c*=0.9 (kappa_max=0.9/tanh^2(0.9)=1.754, kappa range [0.645,1.754], kappa0=1.064) and its curvature field is detached, so it has no trainable free constant; plus per-level residual renormalisation, which is a direct answer to level-3 capacity. Weaker points: b_i/pop_i is not the directly measured statistic of E5 and the interaction of differing kappa across codewords inside one chart is scale-biased (its own risk list).
- OCCURVE-RQ: strongest behaviour hook (E5 entropy stratification directly supports an H_i-derived weight) and correct inverse sign vs GEOCAP, but its geometric intensity is a trainable per-level c_l in [1e-3,8] init 1 — a free constant whose own risk list concedes it can drift to Euclidean and leave the geometry decorative; and inverse-occupancy radii can over-sharpen level 1, the only level where a gain has been measured (E8: K=256 level-1 co-location 0.0822).
- parentcurv-rq-2026: fixes level-1 curvature to 1 by construction, i.e. declines to reproduce the only measured separation gain, and keeps the residual chain Euclidean, so it has the thinnest coupling.
Open: none — ordering settled as RSPC-RQ > OCCURV-FIELD-RQ > OCCURVE-RQ > parentcurv-rq-2026.

STAGE 3 — FINAL ANSWER (complete; this record stands alone).
Ranking (best first) with the evidence each placement rests on:
1 RSPC-RQ — E9 predecessor-profile signal (positive shares successor cohort with anchor 0.9291 vs 0.8871 for fixed negatives; profile overlap beats all ten negatives for 0.5898 of pairs) and E10 (118315 directed edges, mean out-degree 5.45) ground the per-pair successor-code prior; E6/E7 show the scored bottleneck is deep-prefix survival (l1_only depth-3 alive 0.156, l1_br depth-4 alive 0.068 with T4 NLL 9.03), which a row-normalised prefix-conditioned prior targets directly; the row-normalisation to mean 1 bounds the global demand inflation that produced GEOCAP's l3_collision 0.549, and every constant (1/lnK, EMA beta, median-margin tau) is derived, no sweep.
2 OCCURV-FIELD-RQ — measured transition reach on the sparse graph of E10 becomes a detached per-(level,codeword) curvature field whose bounds are all derived from the measured clamp c*=0.9 (kappa_max=1.754, kappa in [0.6453,1.754], kappa0=1.0638), so it carries no trainable free constant, and its per-level residual renormalisation is a direct fix for the level-3 collapse; it ranks below RSPC because b_i/pop_i is not the directly measured E5 statistic and its same-chart cross-curvature comparison is scale-biased by its own admission.
3 OCCURVE-RQ — its behaviour weight is the best-supported signal in the bundle (E5 entropy stratification, Spearman(entropy, top1 mass) = -0.973) and it correctly inverts GEOCAP's popularity sign, but the geometric intensity is a trainable per-level c_l in [1e-3,8] init 1, a free constant whose own risk list concedes it can drift to Euclidean and make the geometry decorative, and inverse-occupancy radii can over-sharpen level 1, the only level with a measured gain (E8: K=256 level-1 co-location 0.0822 vs 0.3106 at K=16).
4 parentcurv-rq-2026 — level 1 is fixed at kappa=1 by construction, so it declines to reproduce the only measured separation gain, and its curved operation never enters the reconstruction/residual path (r^(l+1)=r^(l)+(r_q-r).detach(), "reconstruction untouched"), leaving the residual chain Euclidean — the thinnest real coupling of the four; its branching entropy reaches E5 only through a per-parent aggregation.
Objection: all four depend on clearing a level-3 collision gate no measured arm has yet passed and on test_recall@10 > 0.065, a value above every measured beam recall in E6 (best 0.06363, resample), so a single unaudited run cannot attribute any movement to the coupling; E8 also shows the frozen K=256 level-1 partition co-locates only 0.0822 of canonical pairs, so the capacity ceiling may sit outside all four mechanisms.
